zh-CN.name: 地图可视化
zh-CN.description: 将 GeoJSON 数据展示为交互地图，用于查看空间分布、专题样式与分析范围。
features: 绘制点、线、面图层，控制样式与显隐
添加 POI 参考图层，并通过地图选择空间范围
保存带图例和说明的地图截图

en-US.name: Map Visualization
en-US.description: Displays GeoJSON on interactive maps to explore spatial patterns, thematic styles and study areas.
features: Draws point, line and polygon layers with style and visibility controls
Adds POI reference layers and collects spatial selections
Saves map screenshots with legends and descriptions
